basic_details.job_title: Gujarat Road Safety Authority Legal Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: LLB holders can apply for 02 Legal Assistant posts at the Gujarat Road Safety Authority (ગુજરાત રોડ સેફ્ટી ઓથોરીટી), Gandhinagar, a purely temporary, one-time engagement for 11 months with a fixed fee of Rs. 25000/- per month. The essential qualification is an LLB from a recognised university or institution, along with knowledge of computer and MS Office. Applications go to the Commissioner by post, by hand, or by email to [email protected], and the last date is 20 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Candidates can send their applications by post or deliver them in person to this address: Commissioner, Gujarat Road Safety Authority, First Floor, Ankada Bhavan, beside Police Bhavan, Sector 18- 382007, Gandhinagar, Gujarat.
The envelope must be clearly marked "Application for Legal Advisor". Alternatively, the application may be sent by email to [email protected]. The last date for applications is 20 November 2026.
The notice states that the application must include the following details:
Applicant's details: full name, address, date of birth, mobile number and email address.
Educational qualification details for Std 10, Std 12, Bachelor Degree and any other course or qualification: stream, board/university, year of passing and percentage/CGPA.
Work experience, if any: name of the institution, period, designation and main duties/role.
Self-attested copies of other required documents.

content_sections.heading: About Gujarat Road Safety Authority
content_sections.text: The Gujarat Road Safety Authority is a Gujarat government authority in Gandhinagar headed by a Commissioner. Its office is on the First Floor of Ankada Bhavan, beside Police Bhavan, Sector 18, Gandhinagar. The Legal Assistants will handle its legal work, including Supreme Court cases and the directions of the Supreme Court Committee on Road Safety.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following eligibility conditions for the Legal Assistant post: LLB from a recognised university/institution. Knowledge of computer and MS Office. The candidate must hold supporting documents for the relevant qualification and experience. The notice does not ask for a minimum period of experience. The application format has a section for work experience "if any". The age limit is not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice labels the remuneration "ફી" (fee) and fixes it at Rs.25000 /- per month. The engagement is entirely temporary, on a One Time Basis, for 11 months. The service is treated as ended once that period is complete. A Legal Assistant is allowed 01 casual leave in each month. The notice does not mention any allowances on top of the monthly fee.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Road Safety Authority Legal Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following scope of work: Coordinating cases pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court and working with the advocates engaged by the State Government. Preparing Para-wise Remarks, Affidavit, Reply, Written Submission and similar documents for cases in the Hon'ble Supreme Court. Ensuring compliance with the Hon'ble Supreme Court's orders, in coordination with the concerned branches. Implementing the guidelines of the Hon'ble Supreme Court Committee on Road Safety and obtaining compliance from the various stakeholder departments. Preparing and issuing legal notices to government departments, local self-government bodies and other agencies for negligence in road safety work. Drafting agreements, MoUs, guidelines and other legal documents. Examining the legal aspects of the Authority's administrative and road safety decisions. Giving opinions on the legal aspects of applications under the RTI Act, 2005, and handling appeal-related work. Interpreting the laws and rules connected with the Authority's work and preparing proposals for necessary amendments. Other legal work assigned by the Hon'ble Commissioner.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Gujarat Road Safety Authority Legal Assistant
content_sections.text: Candidates can send their applications by post or deliver them in person to this address: Commissioner, Gujarat Road Safety Authority, First Floor, Ankada Bhavan, beside Police Bhavan, Sector 18- 382007, Gandhinagar, Gujarat. The envelope must be clearly marked "Application for Legal Advisor" . Alternatively, the application may be sent by email to [email protected] . The last date for applications is 20 November 2026. The notice states that the application must include the following details: Applicant's details: full name, address, date of birth, mobile number and email address. Educational qualification details for Std 10, Std 12, Bachelor Degree and any other course or qualification: stream, board/university, year of passing and percentage/CGPA. Work experience, if any: name of the institution, period, designation and main duties/role. Self-attested copies of qualification documents. Self-attested copies of experience documents. Self-attested copies of other required documents.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection for the Legal Assistant posts takes place in three steps: After the last date, the office's internal committee scrutinises the applications and documents. Eligible candidates are invited for an interview. The office's internal committee makes the final selection. The decision of the internal committee on selection is final and binding. The interview date has not been announced in the notice.
